title: Smooth cutoff in C_c^∞ equal to one on an open neighbourhood of a compact set inside an open set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let K, O ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P = Euclid P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)) with K compact, O open and K ⊆ O. Then there are a function χ : ℝ^P → ℝ and a set O' ⊆ ℝ^P such that: χ is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ∞); χ has compact support; tsupport χ ⊆ O; 0 ≤ χ(x) ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^P; O' is open; K ⊆ O'; and χ(x) = 1 for every x ∈ O'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ∃ (χ : Euclid P → ℝ) (O' : Set (Euclid P)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ O ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ IsOpen O' ∧ K ⊆ O' ∧ ∀ x ∈ O', χ x = 1
